references.text: The parallel text that gives the instructions for the fourth row of precious stones on the breastpiece: chrysolite, onyx, and jasper
Describes how the stones were to be set in gold settings, the same technique mentioned here
Earlier in the same chapter, the onyx stones are mentioned as being set in gold settings on the ephod
Ezekiel mentions several of the same precious stones, including tarshish (chrysolite), shoham (onyx), and jashfeh (jasper) in his description of the splendor of the king of Tyre
Revelation describes the foundations of the new Jerusalem adorned with precious stones, including chrysolite and jasper
